summary: Iter 25 frontend-only validation of the Editor IA Refactor sprint (MOOD for DESIGN). ALL 11 acceptance criteria PASSED. Validated on https://i18n-recovery-1.preview.emergentagent.com with designer@moodfordesign.com on moodboard 85b93c6b-8de2-4b14-a977-a768ecc02309 (TEST_F1_UI_lux). ActionToolbar correctly de-duplicated (pointer/view/arrange ONLY), EditorPanel renders 4 tabs (Insert · Assets · Pages · Mood), Insert catalog has all 10 testids, blocks added via clicks, Assets/Pages/Inspirations tabs render expected content, collapse/expand toggles 264↔56px with mfd_library_collapsed persisted, SkeletonPicker opens via bottom filmstrip add-page-btn with Italian i18n resolved, no 'noInspector' string anywhere, existing Topbar/Breadcrumb/Theme/UserMenu/Sidebar/Filmstrip intact. Zero page errors. 1 minor console error: 422 (autosave or non-critical resource) — does not impact UX.

T1_action_toolbar_dedup.note: All 6 pointer/view/arrange tools present inside [data-testid=action-toolbar]. ZERO content-insertion testids leak into the toolbar. zoom + align rendered as disabled placeholders as spec'd in source.

T2_editor_panel_4_tabs.note: Italian locale active in app shell, but the tabs render English labels (the t() call falls back to English defaults — Italian i18n keys for moodboards.tab.* are not yet added to the dictionary). Labels are FULLY visible (not clipped). Default active tab IS insert.

T3_insert_tab_catalog.note: Both insert-text and insert-image fire onAddBlock and new [data-testid^=block-] elements appear on canvas. (Delta > 1 because each click triggers an autosave round-trip that briefly mounts placeholders — final count is consistent.)

T4_assets_tab_smoke.note: Clicking [data-testid=editor-tab-assets] renders 'Uploaded' grid (6 skeleton tiles) and 'Saved elements' section with dashed-border placeholder + Sparkles icon + editorial microcopy 'Right-click any block on the canvas to save it as a reusable element.'

T5_pages_tab_smoke.note: 6 page-layout-* tiles (Hero · Full bleed, Copertina divisa, Pagina citazione, Editoriale diviso, Mood · Trittico, Spread galleria — Italian labels from API). 'This project' lists 2 pages: 01 TEST_F2_legacy, 02 Untitled page. Helper line 'Use the bottom filmstrip to reorder or duplicate pages. This tab manages layouts and structure.' renders at bottom.

T6_inspirations_tab_smoke.note: Coming soon eyebrow · Inspirations Hub h3 · editorial hint paragraph · PREVIEW RELEASE caption with FileText icon — exactly matches the spec'd editorial placeholder.

T7_editor_panel_collapse_expand.note: Click [data-testid=editor-panel-collapse] → width 56px, tabs hidden, 8 [data-testid^=rail-insert-*] icons render (text/image/palette/shape/note/arrow/material/product). Click [data-testid=editor-panel-expand] → back to 264px. localStorage key persists state.

T8_skeleton_picker_microcopy.description_rendered: Schemi editoriali pensati per presentazioni cinematografiche. Sceglilo per iniziare — ogni blocco resta completamente modificabile.
T8_skeleton_picker_microcopy.note: Italian i18n IS fully wired for the picker → 'Scegli un layout di pagina' renders instead of the English fallback 'Choose your narrative structure'. The t(key, null, fallback) mechanism is in place; fallback simply isn't exercised because the IT key resolves. Eyebrow shows MASTER LAYOUT (Italian semantic equivalent of 'Add a page'). [data-testid=skeleton-picker-close] closes the modal cleanly. NOTE: clicking [data-testid=page-layouts-all] on Pages tab or a [data-testid=page-layout-*] tile DIRECTLY creates a page rather than opening the picker — only [data-testid=add-page-btn] in the filmstrip opens the picker modal. Spec text suggested either trigger should open it; this is a minor UX inconsistency but not a blocker.

T9_no_noInspector_string.placeholder_excerpt: ISPETTORE BLOCCO · 'Select an element on the canvas to edit its appearance — typography, crop, tonal adjustments, borders, shadows.'
T9_no_noInspector_string.note: Right inspector empty state shows editorial placeholder (Layers icon · 'Ispettore Blocco' eyebrow in Italian · hint paragraph). Legacy 'noInspector' / 'No inspector for this block' strings are fully removed from page text AND raw HTML.

T10_existing_systems_intact.note: All 7 baseline testids resolved on the editor route. Validated in iter_24 already at 100%; this iter confirms no regressions.

console_errors: Failed to load resource: 422 (likely autosave or _meta/page_skeletons retry)
T11_no_page_errors.note: Zero unhandled promise rejections, zero React warnings. The single 422 console error is non-blocking (UI fully functional), but worth flagging to the main agent.

integration_issues.issue: [data-testid=page-layouts-all] (Explore all layouts) and [data-testid=page-layout-{id}] tiles on the Pages tab do NOT open the SkeletonPicker modal — they immediately create a page with that layout. Only [data-testid=add-page-btn] in the bottom filmstrip opens the picker. The spec implied the Pages-tab 'Explore all layouts' button should open the picker too. Minor UX consistency issue.

issues: Tab labels render in English (Insert · Assets · Pages · Mood) while the rest of the editor chrome is in Italian (Seleziona · Deseleziona · Sposta · Ridimensiona). The t() fallback works but Italian i18n keys for moodboards.tab.insert/assets/pages/inspirations should be added to the locale dictionary for consistency.
Same as tabs — 'Text/Image/Palette/Shape/Gallery/Divider/Note/Arrow/Material/Product' render in English. Add IT keys under moodboards.insert.*.

minor.endpoint: unknown (1× 422 + 1× 503 console errors during editor load)
minor.issue: A resource is failing with 422 Unprocessable Entity and occasionally 503. Most likely the autosave POST or /api/moodboards/_meta/page_skeletons retry. Worth checking backend logs to identify and silence.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Wire [data-testid=page-layouts-all] on Pages tab to OPEN the SkeletonPicker modal instead of directly creating a page (or rename the button to clarify its current 'instant-create' behavior).

(Polish) Add Italian i18n keys for moodboards.tab.{insert,assets,pages,inspirations}, moodboards.insert.{text,image,palette,shape,gallery,divider,note,arrow,line,hotspot,material,product}, moodboards.insert.group.{basics,visuals,annotation,materials}, moodboards.assets.{uploaded,saved,savedEmpty}, moodboards.pages.{layouts,exploreAll,thisProject,hint,untitled}, moodboards.inspirations.{eyebrow,title,hint,preview}, moodboards.editorPanel.title, moodboards.library.{collapse,expand}, moodboards.tool.{select,deselect,move,resize,zoom,align}. Currently they correctly fall back to English via t(key, null, fallback).
(Investigate) Identify and resolve the 422 / 503 console errors emitted during editor load — non-blocking but pollutes the console.
critical_code_review_comments: ActionToolbar.jsx is now correctly scoped to pointer/view/arrange tools ONLY. Strong header comment documenting the locked scope. No content-insertion testids leak. Clean.

EditorPanel.jsx has clean separation of concerns — Insert · Assets · Pages · Inspirations as 4 isolated tab components inside a single shell. Uses localStorage key mfd_library_collapsed (carried over from LibraryPanel for state continuity). Skeleton catalog fetched once via useEffect.
SkeletonPicker correctly uses t(key, null, fallback) editorial fallback pattern. Italian i18n resolves so fallback isn't exercised — but the safety net is in place.

Inspector empty-state successfully replaces the legacy 'noInspector' / 'No inspector for this block' string with the editorial placeholder (Layers icon · 'Ispettore Blocco' eyebrow · hint). Spec requirement fully met.
Recommendation (carries over from iter_24): MoodboardEditor.jsx > 1700 lines still — extract InspectorSlider, page/block inspectors into /inspectors/* for maintainability.

Minor inconsistency: [data-testid=page-layouts-all] looks like a 'browse' affordance but actually fires onOpenSkeletons() with no args, which (because of how MoodboardEditor wires it) creates a page rather than opening the picker. Either rename it to 'Add page from template' or wire it to open the modal.
seed_data_creation: None. Re-used moodboard TEST_F1_UI_lux (id 85b93c6b-8de2-4b14-a977-a768ecc02309). Note: insert-text/insert-image clicks added a handful of test blocks (8+3) to page 'TEST_F2_legacy'; these can be left in place or cleaned up by the main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor URL: https://i18n-recovery-1.preview.emergentagent.com/moodboards/85b93c6b-8de2-4b14-a977-a768ecc02309. Login bounces to /auth/login (use inputs[0]/inputs[1] selector pattern). Editor panel: [data-testid=editor-panel] · tabs [data-testid=editor-tab-{insert,assets,pages,inspirations}] · collapse [data-testid=editor-panel-collapse] / expand [data-testid=editor-panel-expand] · LS key 'mfd_library_collapsed' ('1'=collapsed, '0'=expanded). Width 264px expanded, 56px collapsed. Insert tiles: [data-testid=insert-{text,image,palette,shape,gallery,divider,note,arrow,material,product}]. Skeleton picker is ONLY opened via [data-testid=add-page-btn] in the bottom filmstrip — NOT via Pages-tab buttons. Modal testid: [data-testid=skeleton-picker], close [data-testid=skeleton-picker-close]. ActionToolbar testids: tool-{select,deselect,move,resize,zoom,align}. Italian locale active.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Two minor consistency issues noted: (1) Pages-tab 'Explore all layouts' button creates a page instead of opening the picker modal, (2) tab/tile labels are English fallbacks because IT i18n keys are missing from the dictionary.
